newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing Yanshan to produce only unleaded petrol.
newsitem.headline: Beijing Yanshan to produce only unleaded petrol.

text.p: Beijing's Yanshan oil refinery will be able to produce unleaded petrol at an annual rate of one million tonnes by the end of this year, Chinese oil officials said on Tuesday.

The Yanshan refinery will be producing only unleaded petrol by the year-end in line with government policy to phase out leaded fuel by the turn of the century, a Yanshan Petrochemical Corp official told Reuters during an oil conference in Beijing.
But the official, who asked not to be identified, said actual output this year would not reach the one million tonne level due to preparations for the shift to unleaded petrol production.
He gave no precise figures for current production at the refinery and did not say how much of current output was now unleaded fuel.

Other officials at China Petrochemical Corp -- or SINOPEC, the parent company of the Beijing Yanshan refinery -- said petrol from other parts of the country, mainly northeast China, would be brought into the Beijing area to meet demand that might not be filled by local production.
